title: One line of .exhibit/labels.jsonl
description: One labeled escaped defect (spec section 8.4). exhibit label checks each line against this schema before it writes the line.

id.description: D- and the fix PR number, with zeros in front to make at least three digits, such as D-004 for PR 4 and D-1234 for PR 1234. exhibit label also checks that it matches fix_pr.

fix_pr.description: The number of the PR that fixed the bug.

introducing_prs.description: The PRs that SZZ linked to the fix and the person kept, highest confidence first. It is empty when the person rejected every link.

rejected_prs.description: The PRs that SZZ linked to the fix and the person rejected, highest confidence first. Lines written before link rejection have no rejected_prs, which means none were rejected.

code.description: A short description of what went wrong: one line of at most 200 characters.

category.description: The kind of bug: one line of at most 60 characters.

would_have_caught.description: The evidence that would have caught the bug: one line of at most 500 characters.

labeled_by.description: person when the person typed the label, with no draft or after throwing the draft away. claude_draft_confirmed when they kept Claude's draft unchanged, and claude_draft_edited when they changed it. exhibit label also checks that a Claude label has claude_draft, and that a confirmed label has the draft's code and category.

claude_draft.description: The draft that exhibit label --claude showed, kept so a change can be seen later. Absent when no draft was shown.

model.description: The Claude model that wrote the draft.

szz_link_rejected.description: true when the person rejected at least one SZZ link of the defect. exhibit label also checks that it is true exactly when rejected_prs is not empty.

known_at_review.description: true when review saw the defect and left it for a later ticket: a deferral, not an escaped defect. false when review did not see it. null when nobody knows. exhibit label proposes true when the fix PR, or an issue it closes, says it follows up the review of a PR that SZZ blamed, and null otherwise. The person confirms or changes it.
